content.introduction: Crypto.com allows US users to buy, sell, and trade over 12,000 stocks and ETFs, as well as 350+ cryptocurrencies, and prediction markets all in one app. The platform is regulated by the SEC and CFTC, and customer accounts are protected up to $500,000 by SIPC. The Crypto.com App offers $0 fee deposits, 24/7 trading, and over 12,000 assets to trade.
body:
Yes, for US users, Crypto.com is an all-in-one financial hub. You can seamlessly manage and trade traditional equities alongside your crypto portfolio. These features are fully regulated by the SEC and CFTC.

   12,000+ stocks and ETFs: Invest in your favorite publicly traded companies and exchange-traded funds.
   Whale Baskets: Diversify your portfolio by investing in curated thematic baskets modeled after top market movers.

What are prediction markets and how do I trade them? [...] Can I manage my crypto, stocks and prediction markets in one app?

Yes, the Crypto.com App is designed so that you can seamlessly manage your entire portfolio in one place. Whether you’re buying the dip on Bitcoin, investing in a trending tech stock or taking a position on an upcoming election, you can execute your entire strategy from a single, secure dashboard. WHAT YOU CAN TRADE Prediction Markets: Trade

Crypto.com enables users to trade over 5,000 stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs).
   Stock trading on Crypto.com is conducted through a US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC)-registered broker-dealer that is a member of FINRA and SIPC; as a member of SIPC, customer accounts have the protection of _up to $500,000 (up to $250,000 for cash claims)_. [...] Crypto.comis one of the most popular cryptocurrency exchanges by US dollar volume traded, and now also offers a gateway to traditional stock markets for US users through Foris Capital US LLC, its fully registered broker-dealer. This platform enables users to trade stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) on Crypto.com.
